# World Bank Group

> Global development institution providing financing, data, research, and policy support to reduce poverty and promote shared prosperity.

The World Bank Group works with governments, private sector partners, and civil society across 189 member countries. Its website spans country and topic pages, project and procurement information, open data, research publications, and operational policies from the World Bank, IFC, MIGA, and ICSID.

## About the World Bank Group
- [World Bank Group Overview](https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are): Overview of the institution, mission, member organizations, and global development role.
- [Leadership](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/leadership): Profiles of World Bank Group leadership and senior management.
- [Organization](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/organization): Structure of the World Bank Group and its institutions.
- [History](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/history): Background on the institution’s origins, evolution, and milestones.
- [Accountability](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/accountability): Information on accountability mechanisms, oversight, and institutional governance.
- [Annual Reports](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/annual-report): Annual reporting on results, finances, and institutional priorities.

## Countries and Regions
- [Countries](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country): Directory of country pages with programs, data, projects, and development updates.
- [Africa](https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/afr): Regional priorities, projects, publications, and news for Sub-Saharan Africa.
- [East Asia and Pacific](https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/eap): Regional strategy, operations, and analytical work for East Asia and Pacific.
- [Europe and Central Asia](https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/eca): Regional development information, lending, and research for Europe and Central Asia.
- [Latin America and Caribbean](https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/lac): Regional programs, publications, and economic analysis for Latin America and the Caribbean.
- [Middle East and North Africa](https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/mena): Regional operations, strategy, and development knowledge for MENA countries.
- [South Asia](https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/sar): Regional initiatives, country engagement, and research for South Asia.

## Topics and Development Priorities
- [Topics](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic): Directory of thematic areas across development sectors and policy issues.
- [Climate Change](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/climatechange): Climate mitigation, adaptation, finance, and resilience resources.
- [Education](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/education): Research, projects, and policy guidance on education systems and learning.
- [Health](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/health): Health systems, financing, nutrition, and universal health coverage resources.
- [Agriculture and Food](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/agriculture): Analysis and operations on agriculture, food systems, and rural development.
- [Social Protection](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/socialprotection): Programs and evidence on safety nets, labor, and resilience.
- [Water](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/water): Water supply, sanitation, irrigation, and water resource management content.
- [Transport](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/transport): Transport infrastructure, mobility, logistics, and connectivity resources.

## Data and Indicators
- [Data](https://www.worldbank.org/en/data): Main hub for datasets, indicators, tools, and data access.
- [World Development Indicators](https://datatopics.worldbank.org/world-development-indicators/): Flagship indicator collection covering development outcomes across countries.
- [DataBank](https://databank.worldbank.org/home.aspx): Custom query tool for World Bank databases and downloadable tables.
- [Open Data Catalog](https://data.worldbank.org/): Searchable portal for country, indicator, and dataset access.
- [Poverty and Inequality Platform](https://pip.worldbank.org/home): Data and methodology for global poverty and inequality estimates.
- [Gender Data Portal](https://genderdata.worldbank.org/): Gender-related indicators and analysis across countries and topics.
- [Microdata Library](https://microdata.worldbank.org/): Survey microdata, documentation, and metadata for development research.

## Research and Publications
- [Research](https://www.worldbank.org/en/research): Research programs, working papers, datasets, and expert analysis.
- [Publications](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication): Hub for books, reports, and flagship publications.
- [Policy Research Working Papers](https://www.worldbank.org/en/research/brief/policy-research-working-papers): Working paper series on development economics and policy.
- [Open Knowledge Repository](https://openknowledge.worldbank.org/): Open-access repository for World Bank publications and knowledge products.
- [World Development Report](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/wdr): Annual flagship report on major global development themes.
- [Global Economic Prospects](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/global-economic-prospects): Global economic outlook with forecasts and regional analysis.
- [Poverty, Prosperity, and Planet Report](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/poverty-prosperity-and-planet): Flagship report linking poverty reduction, shared prosperity, and sustainability.

## Projects, Operations, and Results
- [Projects & Operations](https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations): Search portal for World Bank projects, financing, and results.
- [Projects](https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/projects-home): Browse active and closed projects by country, sector, and status.
- [Procurement](https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/procurement): Procurement notices, contract awards, and bidding opportunities.
- [Finances](https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/financial-management): Financial management resources related to World Bank operations.
- [Results](https://www.worldbank.org/en/results): Institutional and country-level results from World Bank support.
- [Independent Evaluation Group](https://ieg.worldbankgroup.org/): Independent evaluations of World Bank Group development effectiveness.

## Policies, Access, and Accountability
- [Policies and Procedures](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/legal/institutional-and-governance-policies): Institutional policies, governance documents, and legal frameworks.
- [Environmental and Social Framework](https://www.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/environmental-and-social-framework): Standards and guidance for environmental and social risk management.
- [Access to Information](https://www.worldbank.org/en/access-to-information): Policy and procedures for requesting World Bank information.
- [Inspection Panel](https://www.inspectionpanel.org/): Independent accountability mechanism for people affected by World Bank projects.
- [Sanctions System](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/sanctions-system): Information on anti-corruption sanctions and integrity procedures.
- [Integrity Vice Presidency](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/integrity-vice-presidency): Investigations and integrity work addressing fraud and corruption.

## News, Events, and Media
- [News](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news): Latest announcements, feature stories, statements, and institutional updates.
- [Events](https://www.worldbank.org/en/events): Conferences, webinars, and public events hosted by the World Bank.
- [Press Releases](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release): Official press releases on operations, reports, and partnerships.
- [Feature Stories](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature): In-depth stories on development challenges, solutions, and country experiences.
- [Speeches and Transcripts](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/speeches): Speeches, remarks, and transcripts from World Bank leaders.
- [Live](https://live.worldbank.org/): Live and on-demand events, discussions, and expert conversations.

## Learning, Careers, and Partnerships
- [Open Learning Campus](https://olc.worldbank.org/): Courses, learning paths, and training on development topics.
- [Jobs](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/careers): Career opportunities, programs, and recruitment information.
- [Internships](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/careers/programs-and-internships/internship): Internship program information for students and early-career applicants.
- [Young Professionals Program](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/careers/programs-and-internships/young-professionals-program): Leadership development program for early-career professionals.
- [Partnerships](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/partners): Information on collaboration with governments, donors, and organizations.
- [Civil Society](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/partners/civil-society): Engagement resources for civil society organizations working with the World Bank.

## World Bank Group Institutions
- [IBRD](https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd): Information on the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
- [IDA](https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ida): Information on the International Development Association and concessional financing.
- [IFC](https://www.ifc.org/): Private sector development institution within the World Bank Group.
- [MIGA](https://www.miga.org/): Political risk insurance and credit enhancement for cross-border investment.
- [ICSID](https://icsid.worldbank.org/): International arbitration and conciliation for investment disputes.
- [World Bank Treasury](https://treasury.worldbank.org/): Treasury products, bond issuance, and financial risk management information.
